scope: cache-only; zero model forwards; zero training; no old-output overwrite
dictionary: A22 16384 native joint-14-layer shared-z; zero-index block27 residual-post
response: within-document mean native z including zeros; equal documents and domains
tie_break: feature ID ascending; exclude exact AUC=.5 from directed rankings
heldout_replication: discovery-fixed direction; oriented heldout AUC 95% document-bootstrap lower bound > .5; exploratory exposed data

frequency.boundary: cut belongs to lower bin; low support stays unclassified

spectrum.source: R04 true CC_h discovery 30math+30bio documents, positions32:192
spectrum.weights: 1/2 per domain,1/30 per document,1/160 per position
spectrum.basis: reuse archived full PCA only after raw-h weighted covariance/eigen audit; sample-vs-population scalar does not alter directions
spectrum.independent_reference: R07 reuses this same basis; no independent reference claimed

matched_background.pool: all support-eligible nonzero-decoder members INCLUDING selected; conservative conditional dictionary reference, not independent null
matched_background.strata: original frequency low/mid/high/insufficient x floor(total discovery positive-doc support/10)
matched_background.draw: same counts in each stratum; without replacement, math/bio draws disjoint; selected inclusion is reported
matched_background.uncertainty: reference distribution across matched dictionary draws; not selection/bootstrap/generalization interval

contribution.input: all 40 original heldout natural documents,160 positions each
contribution.vector: sum native z times TRAIN-RMS-restored decoder before projection and squaring; bias excluded
contribution.aggregation: token mean within doc, then doc mean within domain; normalize group/domain energy over full1024 PCs
contribution.zero_guard: total mean squared vector norm <=1e-12 model-units squared -> no proportions

tokens.frequency_panel: all120 math+bio natural documents positions32:192; equal domain/doc lengths; no reference-DCLM token frequencies
tokens.bins: quantiles1/3,2/3 of counts over distinct observed token IDs, higher empirical quantile; ties unsplit lower bin inclusive
tokens.special: all valid input positions retained, including punctuation/subwords; report any special IDs explicitly
tokens.high_event: strictly greater than per-feature 90th percentile of discovery positive native-z values
tokens.aggregation: per feature token-bin event proportions, then equal-feature mean; insufficient retained separately
tokens.examples: first three discovery-ranked members per direction; at most one high example/document; same token ID low example in a different document if available; no future text

context.cache: 384 R07/R08 target rows;24 discovery/12development/12heldout paired families x2domains x2wordings x2endings
context.A: same target token within ending; family-paired math-bio z, per wording and ending; pointwise95% family bootstrap
context.context_recurrence: at least one ending: both wordings discovery and heldout same nonzero direction; ending-averaged CI excludes0 in both splits; >=3 active families per split; record natural-direction agreement separately
context.suffix: paired E1-E0 averaged domains/wordings; discovery and heldout same sign with pointwise95% CI excluding0 and >=3 active families
context.interaction: difference of domain contrasts E1 minus E0; analogous pointwise recurrence
context.multiplicity: exploratory per-member pointwise tags, no confirmatory multiple-member discoveries
context.B: pure target-only replacement absent; example/explanation changes target AND suffix; NOT RUN; no extra forwards
